image_url.description: A link to an image of the item.

item_weight.description: Weight of a single item within item resource. Should be multiplied by quantity to get total weight.

hs_code.description: Harmonized System code used by customs.

vat_percentage.description: The VAT rate applied to the `item_value` amount.

us_customs.description: United States customs information that may be required to clear customs (see Zonos US postal data requirements)

eu_customs.description: European Union customs information for B2C shipments entering from outside the EU. Required for shipments with value not exceeding 150 EUR (see EU customs reform guidance)

merchant_id.description: A unique product identifier assigned by the online seller, marketplace or platform. Always required.

manufacturer_id.description: A product identifier assigned by a manufacturer, producer or product supplier. Always required.

standardized_id.description: A standardised product identifier, assigned by a manufacturer, producer or product supplier that relies on internationally recognised standards. Required when it exists.
